set system host-name CE2.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be disabled

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: The action to be taken on the interface, in this case, 'disable'

set interfaces ge-1/0/0.explanation: The command `set interfaces [interface]` in Junos OS configures or modifies settings for a specified network interface, such as IP address, MTU, or description.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to be configured.

unit 10 family ethernet-switching vlan m.explanation: Configures a VLAN membership for a specific interface unit under the Ethernet switching family.

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The logical unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The protocol family type, in this case, 'ethernet-switching'.

parameters.name: vlan_id
parameters.explanation: The VLAN ID to which the interface unit is to be assigned.

unit 10 family inet address 172.16.1.2/2.explanation: Configure an interface with a specific unit, family type, and IP address

parameters.name: unit_number
parameters.explanation: The unit number for the interface configuration

parameters.name: family_type
parameters.explanation: The family type for the interface configuration (e.g., inet for IPv4)

parameters.name: ip_address
parameters.explanation: The IP address and subnet mask for the interface
